signal_features — ONED signal op

• 資料種類:signal → table

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.signal_features(x, rate=1.0)(要直接呼叫實作,import dsp; dsp.signal_features(x, rate=1.0);從台帳取用則 ops1d.get("signal_features"))

• GPU:無(僅 CPU 參考實作)

用法

用於異常偵測的精簡聲學/振動特徵向量：rms、peak、crest_factor、zcr、spectral_centroid(Hz)、peak_freq(Hz)、bandwidth(Hz)。全部有限——含 NaN / Inf 的樣本會拋出 ValueError，而不是產生 NaN 特徵(自 2026-10-12 起空訊號亦然；此前回傳零)。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

The three spectral entries are built on spectrum, but every one of them is a *ratio* of magnitudes (argmax, a magnitude-weighted mean, a magnitude-weighted spread), so the raw |rfft| convention documented there cancels out and these numbers are unaffected by it. rms, peak and crest_factor are computed in the time domain and never touch the FFT.

Empty input (x with 0 elements) raises ValueError.
